name: io.github.fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt-compact-http
description: Compact MCP server for SAP ABAP ADT over Streamable HTTP: x-sap-* header credentials

headers.name: x-sap-url
headers.description: The SAP system's URL, e.g. https://my-system.example.com.

headers.name: x-sap-login
headers.description: The user of a basic logon, with x-sap-password.

headers.name: x-sap-password
headers.description: The password of a basic logon, with x-sap-login.

headers.name: x-sap-jwt-token
headers.description: A token you hold, sent as a Bearer token (used as it is; the server cannot renew it). Instead of x-sap-login and x-sap-password.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SYSTEM_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: System type, required (here or as --system-type; no default, never guessed, no request header states it): the tools offered, the connector, and how the system's answers are read. Without it the server does not start.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host to listen on: 127.0.0.1 (this machine only) or 0.0.0.0 (every interface).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_MASTER_SYSTEM
environmentVariables.description: System context for on-prem create/update operations (system id), when no x-sap-master-system header states it.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_RESPONSIBLE
environmentVariables.description: Responsible user for on-prem create/update operations, when no x-sap-responsible header (or x-sap-login) states it.
